# EAGLEDEX

> EAGLEDEX is a fully on-chain Uniswap-V2-style AMM running on Integralayer Testnet and ARC Testnet. Users can swap tokens, provide liquidity, create new pools, farm rewards, and explore live pool analytics across multiple chains.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of EAGLEDEX features, supported chains and quick links to swap, pools and analytics.
- [Swap](/swap): Swap any supported ERC-20 token with transparent routing and live price quotes.
- [Liquidity](/liquidity): Add or remove liquidity from existing pools and track your LP positions.
- [Create Pool](/create-pool): Wizard for deploying a new ERC-20/ERC-20 liquidity pool via the on-chain factory.
- [Pools](/pools): Browse every liquidity pool with TVL, 24h volume and APR.
- [Analytics](/analytics): Cross-user TVL and volume analytics indexed from on-chain Swap, Mint, Burn and Sync events.
- [Portfolio](/portfolio): View your token balances, LP positions and historical liquidity activity.
- [Farming](/farming): Stake LP tokens in active farms to earn reward emissions.
- [Faucet](/faucet): Claim testnet tokens used across EAGLEDEX (per-chain availability).
- [Documentation](/docs): Smart-contract addresses, supported networks, FAQ and integration guide.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of all public routes.
